page.notes: The line "Fidem ... rite apprehendit" starts the page and continues from the previous page. The Greek word in brackets (λάβωμεν) is uncertain. The reference "cont: Franz. Disp. 12." sits at the left edge of the text column and may be a marginal note; it is given as a note. "requiri" is the printed word at the line end. The catchword "missum" is partly obscured and uncertain. Long s is printed as f in places (e.g., "inanif-fimum", "Dei fierl") and is rendered as s here.
